# Maulana Sodiqin

> Senior Software Engineer at MrScraper, based in Bandung, Indonesia (remote-friendly). 5+ years building production systems in Rust and TypeScript. Deep specialties: web scraping and anti-bot evasion at browser-engine level, AI agent tooling, Cloudflare edge infrastructure, and reproducible infrastructure with Nix. Open to full-time and freelance engagements.

## Expertise

- Web scraping & browser automation: patched Chromium fork (Cosmium) for container-fingerprint evasion, undetected scraping systems in production at MrScraper, AI-vision browser automation
- Rust systems engineering: published crates (zod-rs, paginator-rs), Axum backends, WASM on Cloudflare Workers, gRPC microservices
- AI agent tooling: terminal coding assistant (Stynx Code), inter-agent orchestration over MCP (Synapse), persistent agent memory on Cloudflare (Truncus), realtime voice (Siren)
- Frontend at scale: React, TypeScript, TanStack, Nx monorepos, micro frontends with module federation, test-driven development
- Infrastructure: Cloudflare Workers/D1/Vectorize/R2, Nix/NixOS fleet management as code, CI/CD

## Current Role

Senior Software Engineer at MrScraper (Nov 2025 – present): building the scraping platform, improved scraping system speed by up to 40%, implemented undetected scraping.
